items.headline: Samuel out at least a couple of weeks
items.summary: Kyle Shanahan says Samuel strained his hamstring "pretty good" against Seattle and will miss at least a couple of weeks. Christian Kirk is unlikely to practice this week either, so San Francisco is very thin at receiver against Washington.

items.headline: Wilson ruled out vs. Buccaneers
items.summary: Mike McCarthy said Wilson (finger) will not play Sunday at Tampa Bay, and ESPN reports he could miss multiple weeks. Pittsburgh is short of receivers.

items.headline: Skowronek out vs. Buccaneers
items.summary: McCarthy said Skowronek (calf) will not play Sunday. With Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. out, the Steelers' passing targets concentrate on the remaining receivers and tight ends.

items.headline: Charbonnet stays out for Thursday night
items.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Charbonnet (knee) will not be activated from reserve for Thursday against Denver, though he was a limited participant on Tuesday's estimate. George Holani keeps the lead role.

items.headline: Jackson has a realistic chance to play at Cleveland
items.summary: A league source told ESPN Jackson (ankle) has a realistic chance to return Sunday, though he was not present for the media portion of Wednesday's practice. Tyler Huntley starts if he sits.

items.headline: Williams listed as a full participant Wednesday
items.summary: Ben Johnson said Williams (hamstring) would be a full participant on Wednesday's estimated report. The Bears have not named a starter for Sunday at Atlanta, but his return looks more likely.

items.headline: Barkley not seen at practice, Smith working on side
items.summary: Barkley (hamstring) was not spotted at the open part of Wednesday's practice, while DeVonta Smith (hamstring) worked on the JUGS machine. Both are still being evaluated for Sunday.

items.headline: Harrison will make his Texans debut in London
items.summary: DeMeco Ryans confirmed Harrison will play Sunday against Jacksonville after the trade. His snap count and target share are unknown, and David Montgomery is not practicing.

items.headline: Henderson out multiple weeks with high ankle sprain
items.summary: An MRI showed a high-ankle sprain, and ESPN reports Henderson will miss multiple weeks. Rhamondre Stevenson is expected to carry a heavier workload, with Corey Kiner moving to No. 2 against the Jets.

items.headline: Marks set for the lead role in London
items.summary: With Montgomery week-to-week, Marks is expected to handle the lead role against Jacksonville. He played 56 of 66 snaps last week after Montgomery left.

items.headline: Stevenson expected to carry a heavier workload
items.summary: ESPN reports Stevenson will take on more work for the next few weeks while TreVeyon Henderson (high-ankle sprain) recovers. Corey Kiner is the No. 2 back.

items.headline: Mitchell expected to miss a fourth straight game
items.summary: ESPN reports Mitchell had a procedure on his finger and is expected to miss Sunday against New England. With Breece Hall also out, the Jets are thin on offense.

items.headline: Penix on track to start vs. Bears
items.summary: Kevin Stefanski said Penix (ribs) will start Sunday if there are no setbacks, and he was a limited practice participant Wednesday.

items.headline: Shipley has a partial plantar fascia tear
items.summary: ESPN reports Shipley could be sidelined multiple weeks, which leaves Dameon Pierce as the main alternative to Barkley.

items.headline: Montgomery not practicing, week-to-week
items.summary: Montgomery (groin) did not practice Wednesday and Ryans called him week-to-week, so Woody Marks is expected to lead the backfield in London.

items.headline: Moore was inactive Monday with a shoulder injury
items.summary: Moore missed the overtime win over the Rams. His status for Sunday at Las Vegas is not yet known, and Joshua Palmer was also inactive.

items.headline: Harris week-to-week with hamstring injury
items.summary: Jim Harbaugh called Harris week-to-week after the loss to Denver. Ladd McConkey was active but played no snaps, and Quentin Johnston is out, so the Chargers' receivers are very thin at Kansas City.

items.headline: Rice did not practice Wednesday
items.summary: Andy Reid said Rice (hamstring) would not practice Wednesday. His availability against the Chargers is uncertain, so Kansas City's target share is uncertain.

items.headline: Judkins moving without a boot
items.summary: Judkins was seen without a boot on his ankle Wednesday and has not been ruled out. Dylan Sampson was designated to return from injured reserve.

items.headline: Concepcion set to practice after concussion
items.summary: Concepcion is progressing well and was set to practice Wednesday, which is a good sign for Sunday against Baltimore.

items.headline: Dowdle limited in practice, expected back
items.summary: Dowdle (toe) was a limited participant Wednesday and the offensive coordinator expects him to return against the Buccaneers. Jaylen Warren could still share the workload.

items.headline: Mayfield did not practice, listed doubtful
items.summary: Mayfield (right thumb) did not practice Wednesday and is listed as doubtful, so Tampa Bay's quarterback against Pittsburgh is unclear.

items.headline: Hall not practicing, week-to-week
items.summary: Aaron Glenn said Hall (quadriceps) did not practice Wednesday and remains week-to-week, so New York's backfield stays thin against the Patriots.

items.headline: Smith-Njigba limited with ankle injury
items.summary: Smith-Njigba was a limited participant again on Tuesday's estimated report ahead of Thursday night at Denver. A reduced role is possible. Drew Lock (forearm) is also limited as the backup quarterback.

items.headline: About 22 mph wind forecast for Steelers at Buccaneers
items.summary: A forecast of around 22 mph wind at Raymond James Stadium can cut deep passing and kicking. Treat it as a negative for passing yards.

items.headline: About 17 mph wind forecast for Cowboys at Packers
items.summary: A forecast of around 17 mph wind at Lambeau Field on Sunday night can cut deep passing. Treat it as a negative for passing yards.

items.headline: Sanders placed on injured reserve
items.summary: Sanders (hip) is on injured reserve, so Cleveland has fewer backs behind Quinshon Judkins, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury.

items.headline: Brown returns to practice from injured reserve
items.summary: New England designated Brown (ankle) for return, which opens his practice window. He is not yet active for Sunday against the Jets.

items.headline: Allen not practicing, Downs limited
items.summary: Allen (groin) did not practice Wednesday and Josh Downs (hamstring) was limited, so Indianapolis' receiver group is uncertain against Tennessee.

items.headline: Olave missed Wednesday practice with illness
items.summary: Olave did not practice Wednesday with an illness. His availability against the Giants is not yet in doubt.

items.headline: McConkey will practice Wednesday
items.summary: Jim Harbaugh said McConkey (foot) will practice, after he was active but played no snaps against Denver. Quentin Johnston is still out.

items.headline: Coker a full participant Wednesday
items.summary: Coker (quadriceps) was a full participant on the estimated report, so he should return at Philadelphia.

items.headline: Charles activated from injured reserve
items.summary: Seattle activated Charles (knee) from injured reserve Tuesday, adding depth at receiver for Thursday night while Jaxon Smith-Njigba is limited.

items.headline: Etienne designated to return from injured reserve
items.summary: Carolina designated Etienne (ankle) to return from injured reserve, which opens his practice window. He is not yet active for Sunday at Philadelphia.

items.headline: Bills coach warns Cook about fumbles
items.summary: Joe Brady warned Cook of "consequences" for costly fumbles, including one in overtime Monday. No change to his role has been announced.

items.headline: Sampson designated to return from injured reserve
items.summary: Cleveland opened Sampson's (knee) return window, adding a back behind Quinshon Judkins. He is not active yet.

items.headline: Spears limited with knee injury
items.summary: Spears was a limited participant Wednesday, while Tony Pollard rested.
